papers.title: Calibrating Predictions to Decisions: A Novel Approach to Multi-Class Calibration
papers.source_facts: Definitions1-2 and Proposition1: input-independent losses and posterior-only decisions, population expected loss. Selected calibration equivalences, fixed-loss K-support compression, approximate absolute discrepancy, linear partition auditing and computational caveat. Selected appendix equivalence and compression proof.
papers.limits: Not an input-side-information or individual guarantee; no unconditional efficient audit solver, label-preserving compression or Macro-F1 guarantee. Experiments/code and complete PAC proofs not audited.
papers.supplements: Selected included appendices where recorded; no separate supplement requested

papers.title: Hardware-Limited Task-Based Quantization
papers.source_facts: Selected system model, fixed quantizer budget, vector-MMSE reduction, scalar ADC limitations, no-overload dither model, linear-MMSE digital mapping and limits, general-design guidelines; selected Proposition1 and Lemma1 proof.
papers.limits: No complete waterfilling proof, experiment/code replication or transfer to nonlinear Born classification. No-overload and uncorrelated-noise conditions retained. Publisher version not independently acquired.

papers.title: Fast Monte-Carlo Approximation of the Attention Mechanism
papers.source_facts: Known approximate matrix multiplication, attention already given, value-projection sampling, W-norm distribution and attention-column maximum budget. Lemma1 and Theorem2 output-norm bounds including 1/delta probability factor; equation9 visually checked.
papers.limits: No CUDA/code or GLUE replication. Integer budget handling not audited; norm error not decision correctness or unknown-Born sampling guarantee. References pages8-9 consulted only for discovery, not added to scientific reading coverage.
